topics.name: Depth camera noise & denoising
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:"depth camera" AND (abs:noise OR abs:denoising OR abs:denoise)
cat:cs.CV AND (abs:"depth denoising" OR abs:"depth restoration" OR abs:"depth enhancement")

topics.name: Time-of-flight & depth sensors
queries: cat:cs.CV AND (abs:"time-of-flight" OR abs:"ToF camera") AND (abs:noise OR abs:simulation OR abs:denoising)
cat:cs.CV AND abs:LiDAR AND (abs:simulation OR abs:sim2real) AND (abs:noise OR abs:"domain gap")

topics.name: Structured light
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:"structured light" AND (abs:simulation OR abs:noise OR abs:reconstruction OR abs:speckle)
cat:cs.CV AND (abs:speckle OR abs:"single-shot") AND (abs:"structured light" OR abs:projector OR abs:"depth camera")

topics.name: Active stereo & specific sensors
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:"active stereo" AND (abs:noise OR abs:simulation OR abs:calibration)
cat:cs.CV AND (abs:Photoneo OR abs:Orbbec OR abs:RealSense OR abs:"Azure Kinect") AND (abs:noise OR abs:simulation OR abs:denoising OR abs:calibration)

topics.name: Point cloud denoising & sim2real
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:"point cloud" AND (abs:denoising OR abs:"noise removal")
cat:cs.CV AND abs:"point cloud" AND (abs:sim2real OR abs:"domain adaptation" OR abs:"real2sim")

topics.name: Depth sim2real / real2sim
queries: cat:cs.CV AND abs:depth AND (abs:sim2real OR abs:"sim-to-real" OR abs:"sim to real")
cat:cs.RO AND abs:depth AND (abs:simulation OR abs:sim2real) AND (abs:noise OR abs:sensor)

topics.name: Learned sensor noise synthesis
queries: cat:cs.CV AND (abs:"noise model" OR abs:"noise synthesis") AND (abs:camera OR abs:sensor OR abs:depth)

topics.name: VLA & robotics with depth
queries: cat:cs.CV AND (abs:VLA OR abs:"vision-language-action") AND (abs:depth OR abs:3D) AND (abs:noise OR abs:sensor OR abs:simulation OR abs:uncertainty)
cat:cs.RO AND (abs:"depth image" OR abs:pointcloud) AND (abs:policy OR abs:manipulation OR abs:grasping) AND (abs:noise OR abs:sim2real OR abs:simulation)

topics.name: Depth foundation models & metric depth
queries: cat:cs.CV AND (abs:"depth foundation model" OR abs:"metric depth" OR abs:"depth estimation") AND (abs:noise OR abs:robust OR abs:uncertainty)

topics.name: Sensor simulation (robotics)
queries: cat:cs.RO AND (abs:"sensor noise" OR abs:"noise model") AND (abs:depth OR abs:camera OR abs:LiDAR)
